items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Buddy's name was Bartholomew. Yeah, and that's what I knew, Uncle Jim, Uncle Jim was the one that, and they had the one they called Big Buddy, who was his cousin or something like that.

ctx.x: I knew Nick and Buddy. Yeah.

Buddy's name was Bartholomew. Yeah, and that's what I knew, Uncle Jim, Uncle Jim was the one that, and they had the one they called Big Buddy, who was his cousin or something like that. Did you ever meet him? He used to be out in Alexandria a lot.
No, the one I knew was Nick's brother.
